title: Feature Plan (Phase 2)
description: Front-matter schema for `.harness/plans/feat-NNN.md` — the detailed per-feature sub-plan the planning subagent produces in Phase 2 after the overall plan (Phase 1) is approved. Extends today's plan shape (overview, flow diagram, files-to-touch, task summary, dependencies, risks) with the richer sections listed below. Backward-compatible: plans without the new sections raise a soft warning, not tier-1.

featId.description: Feature identifier the plan belongs to

overallPlan.description: Relative path to the Phase 1 overall plan this sub-plan derives from (canonical value: `.harness/plans/overview.md`)

status.description: Draft until the breakdown is approved; approved once harness_create_tasks has been called for its tasks.

commitType.description: Conventional Commits type proposed for the feature's commit subject. Editable at commit approval.

expectedServices.description: Optional planning-time hint: .NET service names the feature is expected to touch (.csproj basenames). Auto-detected services at commit time are authoritative.
